newsitem.title: UK: Rentokil off on profit-taking, UBS downgrade.
newsitem.headline: Rentokil off on profit-taking, UBS downgrade.

text.p: Shares in Rentokil Initial Plc fell for the fourth consecutive session on Wednesday as investors took profits, dealers said.
Rentokil shares, which have risen by 14 percent during the four weeks ended February 12, were down 9-1/2p to 471-1/2 at 1107 GMT.
"The shares have had a good run and I think we're just seeing a bit of profit-taking," said one market maker.
Brokerage UBS yesterday trimmed its earnings estimates, which may have encouraged selling, dealers said.
The analyst could not be reached immediately to comment.
The downgrade from UBS follows comments last week from SBC Warburg suggesting clients to take profits on the shares. --London Newsroom +44-171-542-4026
